songs.title: KUNG MAYROONG DIYOS
slides:
Kung mayroong Diyos, kay gaan ng buhay
Kung mayroong Diyos, di na malulumbay.
Kung mayroong Diyos, may awit na kay lambing,
Ang pagod mo ay papawiin

Kung mayroong poot, sagot Niya ay pag-ibig.
Kung mayroong lungkot, Siya ang makakapiling.
Kung mayroong Diyos kahit na may dilim,
Ang araw mo ay sisikat din.

‘Di ko na maaring ipagpalit,
Ang aking Diyos kahit isang saglit,
‘Di na mawawaglit.
Kasaganaan at karangyaa’y kakalimutan
At tatalikuran,
Sapagka’t ang aking Diyos
Ang tunay na yaman.

Kung mayroong unos at kay bigat ng puso,
‘Di maliligaw sa agos ng mundo.
Kung mayroong Diyos kahit na may gulo,
Kapayapaan ay mapapasaiyo

Kung ang buhay mo’y wala ng pag-asa,
Kung mayroong Diyos, may bukas na kay saya!
Kung mayroong Diyos sa buhay mo sana ngayon,
Ang pag-ibig Niya’y habang panahon

‘Di ko na maaring ipagpalit,
Ang aking Diyos kahit isang saglit,
‘Di na mawawaglit.
Kasaganaan at karangyaa’y kakalimutan
At tatalikuran,
Sapagka’t ang aking Diyos
Ang tunay na yaman.
(Repeat 2x)

songs.title: LET HEAVEN REJOICE
slides:
Let heaven rejoice and earth be glad
Let all creation sing.  Let children proclaim
Through ev’ry land, “Hosanna to our King.”

Sound the trumpet into the night;
The day of the Lord is near.
Wake His people, lift your voice,
Proclaim it to the world

Let heaven rejoice and earth be glad
Let all creation sing.  Let children proclaim
Through ev’ry land, “Hosanna to our King.”

Rise in splendor, shake off your sleep;
Put on your robes of joy.
And in the morning you shall see
The glory of the Lord

Let heaven rejoice and earth be glad
Let all creation sing.  Let children proclaim
Through ev’ry land, “Hosanna to our King.”

Raise your voices, be not afraid.
Proclaim it in ev’ry land:
Christ has died, but He has risen;
He will come again

Let heaven rejoice and earth be glad
Let all creation sing.  Let children proclaim
Through ev’ry land, “Hosanna to our King.”

Sing a new song unto the Lord,
For He has done wonderful deeds.
And praise Him, thank Him, dance before Him,
Play before the Lord.

Let heaven rejoice and earth be glad
Let all creation sing.  Let children proclaim
Through ev’ry land, “Hosanna to our King.”

Nations tremble, wise men amazed,
Child is born this night.
Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty God,
A Father, Prince of Peace

Let heaven rejoice and earth be glad
Let all creation sing.  Let children proclaim
Through ev’ry land, “Hosanna to our King.”

Songs-of angels, “Glory on high,
And peace to men on earth,
I bear glad tidings: Born this day,
Your Savior and your God.”

Let heaven rejoice and earth be glad
Let all creation sing.  Let children proclaim
Through ev’ry land, “Hosanna to our King.”

songs.title: LET HIS VOICE BRING YOU HOME
slides:
Did you hear the voice of the Lord?
Reaching out to you like a dream
Calling your name through the blowing wind
Whispering “I am here”

Did you hear the voice of the Lord?
Did you feel the warmth of His love?
Healing your heart from the hurting it feels
Whispering “I am here”

Come out of the darkness 
through a shining beam of hope
Listen closely now that you feel you are alone
Just a breath by your shoulder, 
you are never on your own
Believe and trust in Him, let His voice bring you home

Did you see His tracks on your path?
Leading the way to His heart
Holding you tight in each moment you fear
And whispering “I am here”

Come out of the darkness
through a shining beam of hope
Listen closely now that you feel you are alone
Just a breath by your shoulder, 
you are never on your own
Believe and trust in Him, 
let His voice bring you home

songs.title: LET ME BE A SHINING LIGHT
slides:
Let me be a shining light
Let me be a shining light
Let me be a shining light
To the nations

Let me be a song of joy
Let me be a song of joy
Let me be a song of joy
To the people of the world

You are my Lord and my King
You give me hope, faith and strength
Hold me and shape me and fill me with desire
To love You and serve You all my life

songs.title: LET THE FIRE FALL
slides:
Holy Spirit (Holy Spirit) come with your fire!
Holy Spirit (Holy Spirit) come with your fire!
Holy Spirit come with your fire
Holy Spirit come with your fire

Come, Holy Spirit.  Let the fire fall
Come, Holy Spirit.  Let the fire fall
Let the fire fall
Let the fire fall

Holy Spirit (Holy Spirit) purify my heart!
Holy Spirit (Holy Spirit) purify my heart!
Holy Spirit purify my heart!
Holy Spirit purify my heart!

Come, Holy Spirit.  Let the fire fall
Come, Holy Spirit.  Let the fire fall
Let the fire fall
Let the fire fall

Holy Spirit (Holy Spirit) set my life on fire!
Holy Spirit (Holy Spirit) set my life on fire!
Holy Spirit set my life on fire!
Holy Spirit set my life on fire!

Come, Holy Spirit.  Let the fire fall
Come, Holy Spirit.  Let the fire fall
Let the fire fall
Let the fire fall
Let the fire fall! (2x)

songs.title: LET THE RIGHTEOUS BE GLAD
slides:
Let God arise, let His enemies be scattered
Let those who hate Him flee before Him!
As smoke is driven, so drive them away;
As wax melts before the fire.

Let the righteous be glad,
Exulting before God jubilant with joy
Sing to God, sing praises to His name,
Lift up a song to Him who rides upon the clouds

O God when You went forth before Your people,
When you marched through the wilderness,
The earth quaked, the heavens poured down rain
At the presence of the God of Israel.

Let the righteous be glad,
Exulting before God jubilant with joy
Sing to God, sing praises to His name,
Lift up a song to Him who rides upon the clouds

With mighty chariots, thousands upon thousands
The Lord came to the holy place
You ascended leading captives in your train
And receiving gifts among men

Let the righteous be glad,
Exulting before God jubilant with joy
Sing to God, sing praises to His name,
Lift up a song to Him who rides upon the clouds

Summon your might
O God, show forth your strength,
You who have conquered for us
Our God is a God of salvation;
To Him belongs escape from death

Let the righteous be glad,
Exulting before God jubilant with joy
Sing to God, sing praises to His name,
Lift up a song to Him who rides upon the clouds

He sends forth His voice, His mighty voice,
He who rides in the ancient heavens.
Sling to God, O kingdoms of the earth,
Sing praises to the Lord

Let the righteous be glad,
Exulting before God jubilant with joy
Sing to God, sing praises to His name,
Lift up a song to Him who rides upon the clouds

Awesome is the Lord in His sanctuary,
Whose majesty is over Israel.
He gives power and strength to His people;
Blessed be our God!

Let the righteous be glad,
Exulting before God jubilant with joy
Sing to God, sing praises to His name,
Lift up a song to Him who rides upon the clouds

songs.title: LET THE SAINTS BE JOYFUL
slides:
Let the saints be joyful in glory,
Let the high praises of God be in their mouth
And a two edged sword in their hand.
Let the saints be joyful in glory,
Let the high praises of God be in their mouth
And a two edged sword in their hand

Enter his gates with thanksgiving
Enter his courts with praise!
Be thankful to him, bless his name.

For the Lord is good and his mercy is everlasting
And his truth endureth for all time!

Let the saints be joyful in glory,
Let the high praises of God be in their mouth
And a two edged sword in their hand.
Let the saints be joyful in glory,
Let the high praises of God be in their mouth
And a two edged sword in their hand

songs.title: LET THE VALLEYS BE RAISED
slides:
Let the valleys be raised
And the mountains made low.
Ev’ry meadow and field overturn.
Make the pathway straight
And the highway run smooth
For the coming of God in our day

God has come to His people as He promised of old.
He has raised up a Savior in the sight of us all.

Let the valleys be raised
And the mountains made low.
Ev’ry meadow and field overturn.
Make the pathway straight
And the highway run smooth
For the coming of God in our day

You, little child, go before Him
Like the prophets of old,
Bringing news of His coming by the mercy of God.

Let the valleys be raised
And the mountains made low.
Ev’ry meadow and field overturn.
Make the pathway straight
And the highway run smooth
For the coming of God in our day

God has come like the morning 
on the darkness of night
As a light to the people, like the breaking of day.

songs.title: LET US EXALT HIS NAME TOGETHER
slides:
Let us exalt His name together forever
I sought the Lord; He heard me
And delivered me from my fears.
Let us exalt His name together forever
Oh, sing His praises magnify the Lord.

The angel of the Lord encamps
‘round those who fear His name
To save them and deliver them from harm.
Though lions roar with hunger
We lack for no good thing.
No wonder, then, we praise Him with our song.

Let us exalt His name together forever
I sought the Lord; He heard me
And delivered me from my fears.
Let us exalt His name together forever
Oh, sing His praises magnify the Lord.

Come, children now and hear me
If you would see long life
Just keep your lips from wickedness and lies.
Do good and turn from evil;
Seek peace instead of strife.
Love righteousness and God will hear your cry

Let us exalt His name together forever
I sought the Lord; He heard me
And delivered me from my fears.
Let us exalt His name together forever
Oh, sing His praises magnify the Lord.

Oh, sing His praises magnify the Lord.

songs.title: LET US PRAISE HIM
slides:
Let us sing, let us sing for joy to the Lord 
	(let us sing, let us sing for joy)
Shout aloud to the rock of our salvation
Let us come before Him with thanksgiving 
	(let us come before Him)
Let us praise Him with our music and our song

Let us sing, let us sing the word of the Lord 
	(let us sing, let us sing His word)
Spread the wings of the Spirit He has given us
Let all men be saved  through our Redeemer
	(let all men be saved)
Let us praise Him with our music and our song

Let us sing, let us sing in honor of the Lord 
	(let us sing, let us honor Him)
Raise our hands in surrender to the King of Kings
Glorify  and exalt His name forever
	(Glorify and exalt His name)
Let us praise Him with our music and our song

Alleluia, alleluia to the Lord 
	(alleluia to the Lord)
Alleluia, alleluia to the Lord
Glorify  and exalt His name forever
	(Glorify and exalt His name)
Alleluia, alleluia to the Lord

Let us sing, let us sing for peace to the Lord 
	(Let us sing, let us sing for peace)
With the Christ in our hearts we’re a new creation
By the power of God we are united
	(By His power we are one)
Let us praise Him with our music and our song

Let us sing, let us sing for joy to the Lord 
	(let us sing, let us sing for joy)
Shout aloud to the rock of our salvation
Let us come before Him with thanksgiving 
	(let us come before Him)

Let us praise Him with our music
	(Let us praise Him with our music)

Let us praise Him with our song
	(Let us praise Him with our song)

Let us praise Him with our music…
And our song.

songs.title: LET YOUR GLORY FILL THIS HOUSE
slides:
Let Your glory fill this house
And Your presence fill our hearts as Your praise
fills our mouths, O Lord my God
(Sing twice)

Lord my God, O Lord my God, O Lord my God

songs.title: LETTER TO GOD
slides:
Dear God, can you hear me
I’m calling out Your name
All the hurt deep within me,
To You I lift up my pain

Dear God, can You see me, broken as I am
Blinded by my selfishness, make me whole again

It’s so hard to be good
And it’s draggin’ me down
All the sins I keep repeating over and over again
Teach me to do as I should
Be more faithful and true
Grant me strength to You I implore
Touch my heart, Lord, I’m yours

Dear God, can You feel me
I’m reaching out for you
By Your grace, You took my hand
And made my life anew
Oh, dear God, be with me
Never leave my side
Without You Lord I am nothing
And I need You in my life

It’s so hard to be good
And it’s draggin’ me down
All the sins I keep repeating over and over again
Help me see this through,
I offer to You
I love You forever more
You’ve touched my heart, Lord I’m Yours
Yours Truly

songs.title: LIFT HIGH THE BANNERS OF LOVE
slides:
Lift high the banners of love, Hallelujah
Sound the trumpets of war
Christ has gotten us the vict’ry, Hallelujah.
Jericho must fall

The body of Christ is an army
Fighting powers unseen
Bringing the captives to freedom
In the name of Jesus our King

Lift high the banners of love, Hallelujah
Sound the trumpets of war
Christ has gotten us the vict’ry, Hallelujah.
Jericho must fall

Brothers, are you sure of your calling?
Will you fight for Jesus the King?
Are you prepared in this battle
To lay down your lives for your friends?

Lift high the banners of love, Hallelujah
Sound the trumpets of war
Christ has gotten us the vict’ry, Hallelujah.
Jericho must fall

We must stand in unity by the spirit made strong
Stand with Jesus, our captain
And fight till God’s kingdom has come

Lift high the banners of love, Hallelujah
Sound the trumpets of war
Christ has gotten us the vict’ry, Hallelujah.
Jericho must fall

Preach the Saviour crucified, dead but risen again
Come against the powers of darkness
In His glorious name

Lift high the banners of love, Hallelujah
Sound the trumpets of war
Christ has gotten us the vict’ry, Hallelujah.
Jericho must fall

In the name of God the Father
In the name of Jesus His Son
And in the name of the Spirit
We will fight till we are called home

Lift high the banners of love, Hallelujah
Sound the trumpets of war
Christ has gotten us the vict’ry, Hallelujah.
Jericho must fall

songs.title: LIFT HIGH THE CROSS OF CHRIST
slides:
Lift high the cross of Christ!
Rejoice in the cross of Christ!
It was there our Savior hung
There our vict’ry was won!
Lift high the cross of Christ!

How was our salvation won?
It was the cross of Christ!
How were sin and death undone?
It was the cross of Christ!

Lift high the cross of Christ!
Rejoice in the cross of Christ!
It was there our Savior hung
There our vict’ry was won!
Lift high the cross of Christ!

How were our diseases healed?
It was the cross of Christ!
How was the law of death repealed?
It was the cross of Christ!

Lift high the cross of Christ!
Rejoice in the cross of Christ!
It was there our Savior hung
There our vict’ry was won!
Lift high the cross of Christ!

What set all the captives free?
It was the cross of Christ!
Opened the gates for you and me?
It was the cross of Christ!

Lift high the cross of Christ!
Rejoice in the cross of Christ!
It was there our Savior hung
There our vict’ry was won!
Lift high the cross of Christ!

songs.title: LIFT UP YOUR HEADS O GATES
slides:
Lift up, lift up your heads, O gates.
And be lifted up, O ancient doors,
Lift up, lift up your heads, O gates,
That the King of Glory may come in.

The earth is the Lord’s and the fullness thereof,
The world and those who dwell therein,
For he has founded it upon the seas
And established it upon the rivers.

songs.title: LIFT UP YOUR HEADS, O GATES
slides:
Lift up, lift up your heads, O gates.
And be lifted up, O ancient doors,
Lift up, lift up your heads, O gates,
That the King of Glory may come in.

Who shall ascend the hill of the Lord
And who shall enter His holy place?
He who has clean hands and a pure heart
And does not lift up his soul to what is false

Lift up, lift up your heads, O gates.
And be lifted up, O ancient doors,
Lift up, lift up your heads, O gates,
That the King of Glory may come in.

Who is this King of Glory?  The Lord strong and mighty.
Mighty in battle, the Lord of Hosts,
He is the King of Glory.

Lift up, lift up your heads, O gates.
And be lifted up, O ancient doors,
Lift up, lift up your heads, O gates,
That the King of Glory may come in.

King of Glory may come in.

songs.title: LIFT YOUR BANNERS HIGH
slides:
What can stand against the Lord
And against the praises of His saints (2x)
Lift your banners high, God our righteousness
He’s coming to His people
Lift your banners high, God our righteousness
He’s coming to His temple

songs.title: LIGHT TO THE NATIONS
slides:
I hear a voice calling out my name
Telling me to come out of the dark.
Out of the dark and into the light
Into the light of life.

I hear a voice calling me by name
Telling me to prepare the way.
Spread the word, the word of love
Spread the news, the news of life
And I can hear the voice say…

I am the Lord your God.
I knew you before you were born.
You are my friend, and you are my instrument.
Through you I will bring light to the nations

But why me Lord, I am not worthy,
I am young and I am weak.
I’m not a prophet, I’m not a king
Yet you’ve called me to conquer nations

I have searched all of my life
For love, only to find
Pain and scorn and briar and thorn
How can I live until the morn
And then I heard the voice say…

I have felt your pain,
And I have cried your endless tears.
I will be your rock, and I will be your healer.
Trust in me, I will be your guide

I am the Lord your God,
I knew you before you were born.
You are my friend, and you are my instrument,
Through you I will bring light to the nations.

songs.title: LIKE EAGLES
slides:
O my soul, do you not know
Have you not heard
It’s been told from the beginning
The Lord your God
Is in your side

O my soul, don’t be afraid
Hope in the Lord
By his righteousness and power
He will strengthen, He will guide

(And) I will soar with wings like eagles
Held by the hands of God
I will run and grow tired
But on his name I call 
For the Lord is never weary
His ways are beyond my thoughts 
I will trust in him with all my heart

O my soul, do you not know
Have you not heard
It’s been told from the beginning
The Lord your God
Is in your side

O my soul, don’t be afraid
Hope in the Lord
By his righteousness and power
He will strengthen, He will guide

(And) I will soar with wings like eagles
Held by the hands of God
I will run and grow tired
But on his name I call 
For the Lord is never weary
His ways are beyond my thoughts 
I will trust in him with all my heart

And I will rest upon his promise
Patiently I wait

songs.title: LOOK BEYOND
LORD JESUS WE ENTHRONE YOU
slides:
Lord Jesus we enthrone You.
We proclaim You are King
Standing here in the midst of us.
We raise You up with our praise.
And as we worship build a throne
And as we worship build a throne
And as we worship build a throne
Come Lord Jesus and take your place.

songs.title: LORD I LIFT YOUR NAME ON HIGH
slides:
Lord, I lift Your name on high
Lord, I love to sing Your praises
I’m so glad You’re in my life
I’m so glad You came to save us

You came from heaven to earth  to show the way
From the earth to the cross my debt to pay
From the cross to the grave from the grave to the sky
Lord, I lift Your name on high

Lord, I lift Your name on high
Lord of wonder and salvation
With one voice we magnify
God of every generation  

You came from heaven to earth  to show the way
From the earth to the cross my debt to pay
From the cross to the grave from the grave to the sky
Lord, I lift Your name on high

songs.title: LORD IS BLESSING ME RIGHT NOW
slides:
The Lord is blessing me right now, right now
The Lord is blessing me right now, right now
You may not be able to see.
All the Lord has done for me,
But the Lord is blessing me right now, right now.

songs.title: LORD IS PRESENT IN HIS SANCTUARY
slides:
The Lord is present in His sanctuary
Let us praise the Lord!
The Lord is present in His people gathered here
Let us praise the Lord!
Praise Him, Praise Him let us praise the Lord!
Praise Him, Praise Him let us praise Jesus!

The Lord is present in His sanctuary
Let us sing to the Lord!
The Lord is present in His people gathered here
Let us sing to the Lord!
Sing to Him, sing to Him, let us sing to the Lord!
Sing to Him, sing to Him, let us sing to Jesus!

The Lord is present in His sanctuary
Let us delight in the Lord!
The Lord is present in His people gathered here
Let us delight in the Lord!
Delight in Him, delight in Him
Let us delight in the Lord!
Delight in Him, delight in Him
Let us delight in Jesus!

The Lord is present in His sanctuary
Let us love the Lord!
The Lord is present in His people gathered here
Let us love the Lord!
Love Him, love Him, let us love the Lord!
Love Him, love Him, let us love Jesus!

songs.title: LORD YOU ARE EVERYTHING TO ME
slides:
Lord You are my strength
Lord You are my life
Lord You are everything to me
Because You’re my only one

Whenever the darkness falls on me
You were always there to bring the light for me
Whenever Satan brings the words of temptation
You were always there to carry me
Through Your salvation

Lord You are my hope
Lord You are my happiness
Lord You are everything to me
And I’m yours forever more 

Whenever the darkness falls on me
You were always there to bring the light for me
Whenever Satan brings the words of temptation
You were always there to carry me
Though Your salvation

songs.title: MAKE MY HEART YOUR DWELLING PLACE
slides:
Make my heart your dwelling place
A temple just for You
A consecrated resting place, a vessel every true
Make my heart a fire, with the brightness of Your Son,
Make my heart a dwelling place,
For the Holy One

(Swing twice)

songs.title: MAGPASALAMAT KAYO SA PANGINOON
slides:
Magpasalamat kayo sa Panginoon,
Na S’yang lumikha ng lahat ng bagay dito sa mundo.
S’ya’y gumawa ng buwan at mga bitwin,
Upang magbigay ng liwanag sa pagsapit ng dilim.
O magpasalamat sa kanyang mga biyaya at awa.

Magpasalamat kayo sa Panginoon,
Dahil sa kagandahang loob Nya’y magpakailan man
At pagpalain ang Diyos habambuhay,
Na S’yang nagligtas sa kanyang hinirang bayang Israel
O ating purihin ang Poon na mahabagin sa atin.

songs.title: MAPAPALAD
slides:
Mapapalad kayong mahihirap, 
Ang kaharian ng Diyos sa inyo.
Mapapalad kayong nagugutom,
Sapagkat bubusugin kayo
Mapapalad kayong nahahapis,
Sapagkat aaliwin kayo
Mapapalad, Panginoon ang mga katulad mo

Mapapalad kayong maawain,
Kaaawaan kayo ng Diyos.
Mapapalad kayong tumatangis,
Sapagkat liligaya kayo
Mapapalad kayong inuusig,
Maghahari ang Diyos sa inyo
Mapapalad, Panginoon, ang mga katulad mo.

songs.title: MARIANG INA KO
slides:
Sa aking paglalakbay sa bundok ng buhay,
Sa ligaya’t lumbay, maging talang gabay

Mariang Ina ko, ako ri’y anak mo.
Kay Kristong Kuya ko, akayin Mo ako.
Kay Kristong Kuya ko, akayin Mo ako

Maging aking tulay sa langit kong pakay.
Sa bingit ng hukay, tangan aking kamay

Mariang Ina ko, ako ri’y anak mo.
Kay Kristong Kuya ko, akayin Mo ako.
Kay Kristong Kuya ko, akayin Mo ako

Sabihin sa Kanya aking dusa’t saya.
Ibulong sa Kanya; minamahal ko Siya. 

Mariang Ina ko, ako ri’y anak mo.
Kay Kristong Kuya ko, akayin Mo ako.
Kay Kristong Kuya ko, kay Kristong Kuya ko
Akayin Mo ako

songs.title: MATTHEW 5:3-12
slides:
Happy are those who are poor in spirit
For the kingdom of heaven belongs to them
Happy are those who mourn for the Lord
For surely His comfort will be with them
Happy are those who are humble
For they will receive what God has promised

Praise Jesus and jump for joy
Sing His glory and lift your voice
Praise and worship, He saves us all
Dance in the name of the Lord.
Hallelujah, singing with His choir of angels
Hallelujah to the Lord.

songs.title: MINSAN LANG KITANG IIBIGIN
slides:
Mahal, pangako sa iyo, hindi magbabago
Ikaw lang ang iibigin ko.
Kahit ikaw ay lumayo at masaktan ako
Asahan na di maglalaho.

Ang pag-ibig ko’y alay as ‘yo lamang
Kung kaya giliw dapat mong malaman

Minsan lang kitang iibigin.
Minsan lang kita mamahalin..
Ang pagmamahal sa yo’y, walang hangganan
Dahil ang minsan ay magpakailanman.

Minsan lamang sa buhay ko ang ‘sang katulad mo.
Ako rin ba’y iibigin mo?
Dinggin, puso’y sumasamo, sinusumpa sa iyo,
Ikaw ang tanging dalangin ko.

Ang pag-ibig ko’y alay as ‘yo lamang
Kung kaya giliw dapat mong malaman.

Minsan lang kitang iibigin.
Minsan lang kita mamahalin..
Ang pagmamahal sa yo’y, walang hangganan
Dahil ang minsan ay magpakailanman.
(Repeat)

songs.title: MATTHEW 5:3-12
slides:
Happy are those who seek for righteousness
For they will be completely satisfied
Happy are those who are merciful
God has given them His mercy
Happy are those whose hearts are pure
For they will see the Lord our God.

Praise Jesus and jump for joy
Sing His glory and lift your voice
Praise and worship, He saves us all
Dance in the name of the Lord.
Hallelujah, singing with His choir of angels
Hallelujah to the Lord.

Happy are those who work for peace
For they will be called the sons of God
When one suffers in God’s name
There is the Kingdom of God
When you are persecuted in My Name
Great rewards awaits you in Heaven

Praise Jesus and jump for joy
Sing His glory and lift your voice
Praise and worship, He saves us all
Dance in the name of the Lord.
Hallelujah, singing with His choir of angels
Hallelujah to the Lord.
Hallelujah, singing with His choir of angels
Hallelujah to the Lord.

songs.title: MIGHTY KING OF ZION
slides:
Praise You Lord, Mighty King of Zion,
Mighty God of Israel!
Save us Lord from the roaring lion,
Cast down the workings of the infidel!

Oh my strength I will sing Thy praises
Thou O Lord are a shield to me
Oh my King though the battle rages
I look with victory on my enemies!

Rouse Thyself like a roaring fire,
Israel’s Hope Bright Morning Star!
Burn-like chaff the Father of Liars,
Light up creation with Thy blazing power!

songs.title: OPEN YOUR EYES
slides:
Open your eyes, see the glory of our King.
Lift up your voice, and His praises sing.
I love you, Lord.  I will proclaim,
“Hallelujah!” I’ll bless Your name.

songs.title: OUR BLESSED HOPE
slides:
Our blessed hope we find no rest,
Until You reign in righteousness.
Then we shall stand in garments pure,
With all who love Your dwelling fair.

O Son of God, O Word of God, O Light of God
Prepare Your way

This passing age its strife will cease,
Your sons will dwell in endless peace.
Our eyes shall see the death of sin,
All shadows flee, all sorrows end.

O Son of God, O Word of God, O Light of God
Prepare Your way

With hearts afire and set above,
We seek Your face O Son beloved!
Our longing grows for heaven’s sight
Jerusalem, adorned in light.

O Son of God, O Word of God, O Light of God
Prepare Your way

The hour is late, the day draws near
Make haste O Lord Your power stir
May all who live Your name adore
Remove the veil and wait no more

O Son of God, O Word of God, O Light of God
Prepare Your way

God prepare your way

songs.title: OUR GOD REIGNS
slides:
How lovely on the mountains are the feet of him
Who brings good news, good news,
Announcing peace, proclaiming news of happiness.
Our God reigns, our God reigns

Our God reigns, our God reigns,
Our God reigns, our God reigns.

He had no stately form, He had no majesty
That we should be drawn to Him
He was despised and we took no account of Him
Yet now He reigns, with the Most High

Our God reigns, our God reigns,
Our God reigns, our God reigns.

It was our sin and guilt that 
bruised and wounded Him
It was our sin that brought Him down
When we like sheep had gone astray
Our Shepherd came and on His shoulders
Bore our shame

Our God reigns, our God reigns,
Our God reigns, our God reigns.

Meek as a lamb that’s led out to the slaughterhouse
Dumb as a sheep before its shearer
His life ran down upon the ground
Like pouring rain that we might be born again

Our God reigns, our God reigns,
Our God reigns, our God reigns.

Out from the tomb He came with grace and majesty
He is alive.  He is alive, God loves us so, see here
His hands, His feet, His side, Yes we know
He is alive

Our God reigns, our God reigns,
Our God reigns, our God reigns.

songs.title: OUR KING
slides:
Hear His voice, hear Him say,
“I will always love you, each and everyday.”
Heed His voice, come and pray
To the King of all the nations
That His blessings will be great?
Give thanks for everything,
How joyfully we sing,
For the God of all the heavens is our King!

Listen to the people, singing all as one;
Everyone’s preparing for the Kingdom yet to come.

Gather all around Him raising up your voice,

Head the call of Heaven for His name;
So stop and thank Jesus that He died
So we’ll be saved.

Hear His voice, hear Him say,

Heed His voice, come and pray
To the King of all the nations
That His blessings will be great?
Give thanks for everything,
How joyfully we sing,
For the God of all the heavens is our King!

Minsan lamang ako daraan sa daigdig na ito.

Panginoong lumikha ng kalangitan at lupa

slides:

O D’yos, O Panginoon, lahat ay biyayang aming inampon,

Ang tanging ninanais ko,
Ay matamo lamang ang pag-ibig Mo.
Lahat ay iiwanan ko,
Wala nang kailangan, sapat na ito.

songs.title: PAGHAHANDOG NG SARILI
slides:
Kunin Mo, O Diyos at tanggapin Mo;
Ang aking kalayaan, ang aking kalooban,
Ang isip at gunita ko, 
Lahat ng hawak ko, lahat ng loob ko
Lahat ay aking alay sa Iyo.
Mula sa Iyo ang lahat ng ito, muli kong handog sa Iyo

Ayon sa kalooban Mo.
Mag-utos Ka, Panginoon ko, dagling tatalima ako,
Ipagkaloob Mo lamang ang pag-ibig Mo,
At lahat tatalikdan ko.

songs.title: PAG-IBIG NA KAY GANDA

Sa paggising ko sa umagang kay ganda

Sumasamba sa Diyos na Siyang sa atin ay lumikha.

Ang maghapon ay punong-puno ng biyaya
Pagkat ang buhay ko’y sa Diyos iniaalay
Ang tangi kong hangad ay makapiling Siya
Sa umaga’t hapon, sa gabi at magpakailanpaman.

Ikaw ang tangi kong mahal, ang buhay ko
Sa ‘Yo ko lang nadarama, pag-ibig na kay ganda
Pangarap ko sanang mapaglingkuran Kita
At makapiling Ka sa buhay na walang hanggan.

slides:
Panginoon, turuan Mo akong maging bukas-palad,
Turuan Mo akong maglingkod sa Iyo,
Na magbigay ng ayon sa nararapat
Na walang hinihintay mula sa ‘Yo.

songs.title: PANANAGUTAN
slides:
Walang sinuman ang nabubuhay,
Para sa sarili lamang.
Walang sinuman ang namamatay
Para sa sarili lamang.

Tayong lahat ay may pananagutan sa isa’t isa
Tayong lahat ay tinipon ng Diyos na kapiling N’ya

At paglilingkod sa kanino man

slides:
Itaas na ang mga mata sa Panginoong lumikha

Itaas na sa Kanya mga himig at kanta

slides:

songs.title: PATIENCE, PEOPLE

songs.title: PHILIPPIANS 2
slides:
Christ Jesus though in the form of God
Did not grasp equality with God
But emptying Himself took a servant’s form
Being born in the likeness of men

Therefore God has highly exalted him,
And bestowed on him the Name,
That at Jesus’ name every knee shall bow
In heaven, on earth and under the earth,
And ev’ry tongue confess Him Lord
To the glory of God the Father.

Being found in human form
Christ Jesus humbled himself, becoming obedient
Unto death, even to death on a cross

Therefore God has highly exalted him,
And bestowed on him the Name,
That at Jesus’ name every knee shall bow
In heaven, on earth and under the earth,
And ev’ry tongue confess Him Lord
To the glory of God the Father.

songs.title: PILGRIM’S THEME
slides:
Tired of weaving dreams too loose for me to wear.
Tired of watching clouds repeat their dance on air.
Tired of getting tied to doing what’s required.
Is life a mere routine in the greater scheme of things?
Through with taking roads someone else designed.
Through with chasing stars that soon forget to shine
Through with going through one more day.  What’s new?
Does my life still mean a thing in the greater scheme of things?

I think I’ll follow the voice that calls within.
Dance to the silent song it sings.
I hope to find my place, so my life will fall in place
I know in time I’ll find my place in
The greater scheme of things.

Each must go his way, but how can I decide
Which path I should take.  Who will be my guide?
I need some kind of star to lead me somewhere far
To find a higher dream in the greater scheme of things.
The road before me bends, I don’t know what I’ll find
Will I meet a friend, or ghosts I’ve left behind?
Should I even be surprised that You’re with me in disguise?
For it’s Your hand I have seen in the greater scheme of things.

I think I’ll follow the voice that calls within.
Dance to the silent song it sings.
I hope to find my place, so my life will fall in place
I know in time I’ll find my place

For Yours is the voice in my deepest dreams
You are the heart, the very heart of the greater scheme of things.

So here, I’ll follow the voice that calls within
Dance to the silent song it sings.
I hope to find my place, so my life will fall in place.
I know in time I’ll find my place.

Why don’t we follow the voice that calls within
Dance to the silent song it sings
One day we’ll find our place for all things fall in place
For all things have a place in the greater scheme of things.

songs.title: POSSESS THE LAND
slides:
In a world covered in darkness

Possess the land, in the name of Jesus

Possess the land.

In the power of your love

Hold me close, let Your love surround me

In the power of your love

songs.title: PSALM 18
slides:
Yea, Thou dost light my lamp;
The Lord my God lightens my darkness.

For who is God, but the Lord?
And who is a rock except our God?
The God who girded me with strength,
And made my way so very safe.

Yea, Thou dost light my lamp;
The Lord my God lightens my darkness.

He made my feet like hinds’ feet
And set me secure upon the heights.
He trains my hands for war,
So my arms can bend a bow of bronze

Yea, Thou dost light my lamp;
The Lord my God lightens my darkness.

Thou hast given me the shield of Thy salvation,
And Thy right hand held me high,
And Thy help made me great.
Thou didst give a wide place for my feet
And they did not slip

Yea, Thou dost light my lamp;
The Lord my God lightens my darkness.

The Lord lives and blessed be my rock, 
And exalted be the God of my salvation.
For this I will extol Thee,
O Lord, among the nations,
And sing praises to Thy name

songs.title: PSALM 73
slides:
Whom have I in heaven but You O Lord,
And when I am with You,
The earth delights me not!
Though my heart and my flesh should waste away,
God is my rock, my portion forever

Your law is my delight, I hasten to keep your ways.
I rise to bless you at night; by day I sing your praise.

We’re coming to You out of darkness, Lord

songs.title: STRONG AND FAITHFUL
slides:
Our hearts know no fear
Strong and faithful is our God
We are His precious and dear
A rock unmoved He is our God.

For though a thousand may fall
And mountains may crumble
We shall continue to stand
For men who are mighty and tall
May falter and tremble, we shall possess the land
For strong and faithful is our God,
For strong and faithful is our God.

Clouds of night may fill the sky,
Storms that rage may blow the day
But let your hearts rest in your God
He will shield us all the way.

For though a thousand may fall
And mountains may crumble
We shall continue to stand
For men who are mighty and tall
May falter and tremble, we shall possess the land
For strong and faithful is our God, (3x)

slides:
My child I knew you before the world began.
I was there every time you wrote 
your name in the sand.
And lately I know you’ve been through quite a storm
But child I’ve been there 
since the day you were born.

O, and I rule the wind; yes, and I calm the sea
And the sun won’t go down until I say it can leave.
And as sure as My word, 
I’ll stand here right by your side.
And if you’re just too weak to go on…
Remember child… I’m your strong arm.

Now people will wonder and they’ll stand amazed.
They’ll say you are a miracle, and I will be praised.
And even though your pain has been so hard to bear,
Just know that I’m with you and there’s no need to despair.

O, and I rule the wind; yes, and I calm the sea
And the sun won’t go down until I say it can leave.
And as sure as My word, 
I’ll stand here right by your side.
And if you’re just too weak to go on…
Remember child… I’m your strong arm.
(Repeat)

We will not be shaken,
For by your hand we are saved,
O by Your hand we are saved.

slides:

My Lord, please show me how to know just how you feel.

songs.title: THANKS BE TO GOD
slides:
Thanks be to God, thanks be to God.
Blessing, honor, glory and thanks be to you;
Our King and God. 
(Repeat)

We give thanks to Thee, Lord God the Almighty
Throughout all ages, blessed be Your name
For you have taken your great power
And began to reign.

songs.title: THAT BLEST ABODE
slides:
Ah, that blest abode above,
Who shall pass its portals?
Who at length in peace and love
Dwell with the immortals?
They who battle for the right
When the day is longest
They who conquer in the fight
When the foe is strongest

Who shall nearest to the throne
have a place appointed?
Who have greatest favour shown 
by the Lord’s anointed?

They who serve Him gladly now
Ring and Captain royal
Ever mindful of their vow, noble steadfast, loyal

Ah, the bliss of heav’ns abode, rise, my soul to win it!
Shrink not from the weary road, but in faith begin it
List’n not to the call of sense, earth is vain and lying
Yonder is thy recompense

‘Mid a bliss undying (3x)

songs.title: THAT LAST SUPPER
slides:
That last evening spent together
Just bread and wine was their supper
Thanking God that time, He said,
As He blest and broke the bread
“Take and eat my flesh I give to you.”

Then after quite some time
He blest the chalice of wine
Giving thanks to God again
He thus spoke and said to them:
“Take and drink my blood I give to you.”

His body and His blood here, He freely chose to give.
That all men would remember Him and they would believe
A covenant He’s made here forever more since then
That those who would believe in Him
Someday shall live again

Each time I think and remember
That last evening spent together
Sometimes I feel I was there
Once disciple who did share
That last supper with my Lord and God.

His body and His blood here, He freely chose to give.
That all men would remember Him and they would believe
A covenant He’s made here forever more since then
That those who would believe in Him
Someday shall live again

Each time I think and remember
That last evening spent together
Sometimes I feel I was there
Once disciple who did share
That last supper with my Lord and God.

songs.title: THAT’S WHY I PRAISE YOUR NAME
slides:
Teach me, O Lord, and guide me everyday
Make me, O Lord, to live my life with You
Make my heart, Lord, beat with love like Yours
As I offer up myself to You
As what I have promised You my God

Lord, I’m ready to do Your will
Give me a song of praise and I will glorify Your name
Lord, I love to sing You a song
I offer You my sacrifice with all my heart

Oh my Lord, You are faithful, You are worthy
You gave my life to me and graces everyday
Almighty God, You’re my Lord who have an everlasting love
That’s why I praise Your name on high

Teach me, O Lord, and guide me everyday
Make me, O Lord, to live my life with You
Make my heart, Lord, beat with love like Yours
As I offer up myself to You
As what I have promised You my God

Lord, I’m ready to do Your will
Give me a song of praise and I will glorify Your name
Lord, I love to sing You a song
I offer You my sacrifice with all my heart

Oh my Lord, You are faithful, You are worthy
You gave my life to me and graces everyday
Almighty God, You’re my Lord who have an everlasting love
That’s why I praise Your name
(Repeat)

I will magnify Your name on high

songs.title: THE CELEBRATION SONG
slides:
In the presence of Your people
I will praise Your name,
For alone You are holy,
Enthroned on the praises of Israel
Let us celebrate your goodness
And Your steadfast love.
May your name be exalted here on earth
And in heav’n above

songs.title: THE DWELLING OF GOD IS AMONG YOU TODAY
slides:
And then I heard a loud voice say,
Behold the dwelling of God is among you today
And He shall wipe away your tears;
There’ll be no mourning, or crying,
Or pain, or death anymore!
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
For the Lord God Almighty, Omnipotent reigns
Our mighty God, our risen Lord.
All the glory, and honor,
And power are yours ever more

songs.title: THE EARTH SHAKES
slides:
The earth shakes at the sound of His voice,
The nations tremble before Him;
The idols of men are all falling
At the feet of the Lord, our God,
At the feet of the Lord, our God.

The Lord is a warrior, fearless is He,
The Lord is mighty in battle;
His armies outnumber His enemies
When they shout the strongholds of Satan
Come crashing down and Babylon is falling, 
falling down

The earth shakes at the sound of His voice,
The nations tremble before Him;
The idols of men are all falling
At the feet of the Lord, our God,
At the feet of the Lord, our God.

The Lord is a savior, gracious is He,
The Lord is full of compassion;
His army is also His family,
When they shout the strongholds of Satan
Come crashing down and Babylon is falling, 
falling down

The earth shakes at the sound of His voice,
The nations tremble before Him;
The idols of men are all falling
At the feet of the Lord, our God,
At the feet of the Lord, our God.

The Lord has a kingdom, Jesus is King,
We reign forever and ever; He’s given us power
And authority, when we shout
The strongholds of Satan come crashing down
And Babylon is falling, falling down

The earth shakes at the sound of His voice,
The nations tremble before Him;
The idols of men are all falling
At the feet of the Lord, our God,
At the feet of the Lord, our God,
At the feet of the Lord, our God.

songs.title: THE KING THE LORD REIGNS
slides:
The King, the Lord reigns!
His Christ, the Morning Star reigns!
Sovereign, holy, full of love
Hallelujah!  He reigns!
So crown Him Lord of Lords within us.
Crown Him Lord of Lords among us.
Crown the King, the Savior, crown Him Lord.
Yes, crown Him Lord of Lords.
Oh crown Him Lord of Lords!

songs.title: THE LIGHT OF CHRIST
slides:
The light of Christ has come into the world.
The light of Christ has come into the world.

All men must be born again
To see the kingdom of God
The water and the Spirit bring new life in God’s love

The light of Christ has come into the world
The light of Christ has come into the world

God gave up His only Son out of love for the world
So that all men who believe in Him will live forever

The light of Christ has come into the world
The light of Christ has come into the world

The light of God has come to us
So that we might have salvation
From the darkness of our sins
We walk into glory with Christ Jesus

The light of Christ has come into the world
The light of Christ has come into the world

songs.title: THE LORD IS A GREAT AND MIGHTY KING
slides:
The Lord is a great kind mighty King.
Just and gentle with everything.
So with happiness we sing, and let His praises ring.

We are His voice, we His song.
Let us praise Him all day long.  Alleluia 

The Lord is a great kind mighty King.
Just and gentle with everything.
So with happiness we sing, and let His praises ring.

We are His Body here on earth.
From above He gave us birth.  Alleluia.

The Lord is a great kind mighty King.
Just and gentle with everything.
So with happiness we sing, and let His praises ring.

For our Lord we will stand, 
sent by Him to every land.  Alleluia

The Lord is a great kind mighty King.
Just and gentle with everything.
So with happiness we sing, and let His praises ring.

The Lord our God is one:
Father, Spirit and Son.  Alleluia

The Lord is a great kind mighty King.
Just and gentle with everything.
So with happiness we sing, and let His praises ring.

songs.title: THE LORD OF HOSTS IS WITH US
slides:
For the Lord of Hosts is with us
Our refuge is our God alone
Pour out your hearts before your King
Find grace and mercy at His mighty throne

God is our refuge and strength
Our constant help in trouble so we shall not fear
Though the earth itself should change
With God in our midst we shall not be moved

For the Lord of Hosts is with us
Our refuge is our God alone
Pour out your hearts before your King
Find grace and mercy at His mighty throne

Our souls find their rest in the Lord
From Him comes our salvation
All our honor and our deliv’rance rest on God
Our shield and defender, bulwark and strength
In Him shall we stand firm

For the Lord of Hosts is with us
Our refuge is our God alone
Pour out your hearts before your King
Find grace and mercy at His mighty throne

songs.title: THE LORD REIGNS
slides:
The Lord reigns, the Lord reigns
The Lord reigns on earth (Repeat)

Clouds and thick darkness surround Him
He reigns upon His throne, fire goes before Him
And burns up His foes ‘round about!

The Lord reigns, the Lord reigns
The Lord reigns on earth (Repeat)

His lightnings lighten the world;
The earth sees and trembles
Mountains melt like wax before the Lord,
The Lord of all the earth 

The Lord reigns, the Lord reigns
The Lord reigns on earth (Repeat)

The Lord loves those who hate evil;
He will come to their aid.
Light will dawn for the righteous,
And joy for the upright in heart!

The Lord reigns, the Lord reigns
The Lord reigns on earth (Repeat)

Zion hears and is glad
Because of Your judgments, O God,
For You are most high o’er all the earth,
Exalted above all gods!

The Lord reigns, the Lord reigns
The Lord reigns on earth (Repeat)

The heavens themselves show His glory;
All people of the earth can see
That He is creator and there is no God such as He!

The Lord reigns, the Lord reigns
The Lord reigns on earth (Repeat)

songs.title: THE MAGNIFICAT
slides:
My soul magnifies the Lord
And my spirit rejoices in God – my Saviour

For He who is mighty has done great things
And holy is His name
From age to age His mercy is on those who fear Him
He fills the hungry with good things 
He helps those who serve Him

My soul magnifies the Lord
And my spirit rejoices in God – my Saviour

He scatters the proud and He lifts up the lowly
He has shown strength with His arm
For the Word became flesh and He dwelt among us
No one has seen the Father
But the Son has made Him known

My soul magnifies the Lord
And my spirit rejoices in God – my Saviour

The words of the Lord are Spirit and life.
Blessed are the people who hear them and keep them
When God speaks His word, let it be fulfilled in me
For with the Lord, nothing is impossible

My soul magnifies the Lord
And my spirit rejoices in God – my Saviour

And my spirit rejoices in Jesus – my Savior

songs.title: THE MISSION
slides:
There’s a call going out across the land in every nation.
A call to all who swear allegiance to the cross of Christ.
A call to true humility, to live our lives responsibly;
To deepen our devotion to the cross at any price.

Let us then be sober; moving only in the Spirit,
As aliens and strangers in a hostile foreign land.
The message we’re proclaiming is repentance and forgiveness.
The offer of salvation to the dying race of man.

To love the Lord, our God is the heartbeat of our mission
The spring from which our service overflows.
Across the street, all around the world, the mission still the same,
“Proclaim and live the truth in Jesus’ name.”

As a candle is consumed by the passion of the flame
Spilling light unsparingly throughout a darkened room.
Let us burn to know Him deeper
Then our service flaming bright
Will radiate His passions and blaze with Holy light.

To love the Lord, our God is the heartbeat of our mission
The spring form which our service overflows.
Across the street, all around the world, the mission still the same,
“Proclaim and live the truth in Jesus’ name.”
(Repeat)

songs.title: THE PEOPLE OF GOD
slides:
The people of God shines forth like lights
The sword of the Spirit is in their hands
That You O Lord might be glorified
May Your kingdom come

Come together O people of God, let all men see in our
Unity that we live for Jesus the King

The people of God shines forth like lights
The sword of the Spirit is in their hands
That You O Lord might be glorified
May Your kingdom come

Let our hearts not tire and fail burning always
With the zeal for the service of your name

The people of God shines forth like lights
The sword of the Spirit is in their hands
That You O Lord might be glorified
May Your kingdom come

Let the Lord God conquer our fear
So that we might be free
To lay our lives before His throne

The people of God shines forth like lights
The sword of the Spirit is in their hands
That You O Lord might be glorified
May Your kingdom come

songs.title: THE PEOPLE THAT WALK IN DARKNESS
slides:
For a Child is born this day:  Rejoice, rejoice.
Daughter of Zion, awake!  The glory of God is born.

The people that walk in darkness have seen 
Have seen a great light.
And on those who dwell in endless gloom,
A light has shone.

For a Child is born this day:  Rejoice, rejoice.
Daughter of Zion, awake!  The glory of God is born.

And they shall name Him counselor,
Shall call Him mighty God.
And He shall rule from age to age
Prince of peace.

For a Child is born this day:  Rejoice, rejoice.
Daughter of Zion, awake!  The glory of God is born.

Darkness covers the earth;
Thick clouds govern its people,
But the Lord will bring them light.
The Lord will bring them light.

For a Child is born this day:  Rejoice, rejoice.
Daughter of Zion, awake!  The glory of God is born.

The people that walk in darkness have seen,
Have seen a great light.
And on those who dwell in endless gloom
A light has shone.

songs.title: THE PRAYER OF ST. FRANCIS
slides:
Make me a channel of Your peace.
Where there is hatred, let me bring Your love.
Where there is injury, Your pardon, Lord, 
And where there’s doubt, true faith in You

Make me a channel of Your peace
Where there is despair in life let me bring hope.
Where there is darkness only light,
And where there’s sadness every joy.

Oh Master, grant that I may never seek
So much to be consoled as to console,
To be understood as to understand,
To be loved as to love with all my soul

Make me a channel of Your peace.
It is in pardoning that we are pardoned
In giving to all men that we receive
And in dying that we’re born to eternal life

songs.title: THE SONG OF MOSES
slides:
The Lord is my strength and song,
And He is become my salvation.
He is my God and I will prepare Him a habitation,
My Father’s God and I will exalt Him.

He hath triumphed gloriously,
I will sing unto the Lord.  He hath triumphed gloriously,
The horse and his rider hath He thrown in the sea

The Lord is my strength and song,
And He is become my salvation.
He is my God and I will prepare Him a habitation,
My Father’s God and I will exalt Him.

The Lord is a man of war, the Lord is His name.
Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath He cast,
Hath He cast into the sea

The Lord is my strength and song,
And He is become my salvation.
He is my God and I will prepare Him a habitation,
My Father’s God and I will exalt Him.

Thy right hand, O Lord, is become glorious in pow’r
Thy right hand, O Lord, 
hath cast in pieces the enemy.

The Lord is my strength and song,
And He is become my salvation.
He is my God and I will prepare Him a habitation,
My Father’s God and I will exalt Him.

Who is like unto Thee, O Lord, among the gods?
Who is like Thee, glorious in holiness, 
fearful in praises doing wonders?

The Lord is my strength and song,
And He is become my salvation.
He is my God and I will prepare Him a habitation,
My Father’s God and I will exalt Him.

I will exalt Him.

songs.title: THE SONG OF MY SOUL
slides:
Here I am, an empty soul
Walking all alone through my life
Here I am, a lost soul
Looking for a place where I can hid
And find refuge, my long lost peace
And all else that will put my restless soul at ease

So come, my Lord, calm my heart
Pacify the sea that has been tearing me apart
Oh come, my Lord, calm my soul
Take me in Your arms and make me whole my Lord

Here I am, still searching for the place
That every person calls home
Hear my prayer, hear my song
For only unto You do I belong
I’ve searched so hard all my life through
For love that I know will only find in You

So come, my Lord, calm my heart
Pacify the sea that has been tearing me apart
Oh come, my Lord, calm my soul
Take me in Your arms and make me whole my Lord

songs.title: THE SPIRIT AND THE BRIDE
slides:
The Spirit and the bride say “Come”
Let all who hear say “Come”
Let him who is thirsty come
Take the water of life without price

Behold, I am coming soon bringing my reward
I am the Alpha and the Omega
The first and the last, the beginning and the end

The Spirit and the bride say “Come”
Let all who hear say “Come”
Let him who is thirsty come
Take the water of life without price

Blessed are all who wash their robes to eat from
The tree of life and enter the city by the gates
I am the offspring of David
The bright and morning star

The Spirit and the bride say “Come”
Let all who hear say “Come”
Let him who is thirsty come
Take the water of life without price

If any man thirst, let him come to me
And let him drink, and out his heart
There shall flow streams of living water
This is the Spirit, just ask and receive

The Spirit and the bride say “Come”
Let all who hear say “Come”
Let him who is thirsty come
Take the water of life without price

Even so, come, Lord Jesus
Come Lord Jesus

songs.title: THE VICTORY SONG
slides:
We are fighting for Jerusalem the city of our King
And His kingdom will be founded
On the justice He shall bring
And with the light of truth to guide us
This victory song we sing

W:  Salvation and glory and power
        Belong to our God to our God 

M:  Blessing and glory and all power
       And all honor and all wisdom to our God, 
       to our God

With the love of God a flame in us
We brandish a two edged sword
To bring our foes to ruin
As we call upon the Lord and while the wicked
Come against us we proclaim before the horde

W:  Salvation and glory and power
        Belong to our God to our God

M:  Blessing and glory and all power
       And all honor and all wisdom to our God, 
       to our God

As Christ our Lord commissioned us
We carry His word to men as a light
To those in the darkness that to Christ
All knees shall bend and to every tribe,
And nation we declare this truth again

W:  Salvation and glory and power
        Belong to our God to our God

M:  Blessing and glory and all power
       And all honor and all wisdom to our God, 
       to our God

Though a host encamp against us
On Christ have set our face by Him
We shall see triumph in the power of His grace
And as the saints of God surround us
We shall shout in that place

W:  Salvation and glory and power
        Belong to our God to our God

M:  Blessing and glory and all power
       And all honor and all wisdom to our God, 
       to our God

songs.title: THE VOICE OF ONE CALLING IN THE DESERT
slides:
The voice of one calling in the desert
Prepare the way of the Lord
The voice of one calling in the desert
Make straight the paths for the Lord

And ev’ry valley shall be lifted up,
Ev’ry mountain and hill be made low,
And the crooked roads straight,
The rough places plain and then all the world will see
The Salvation of our God.

M:  This is the generation of those who seek the Lord
W:  (This is the generation of those who seek the Lord)
        This is the generation called to prepare His way

So with His armour fit for the fight
With the Sword of His Spirit held tight,
In the strength of His might
Put God’s enemies to flight
And then all the world will see
The Salvation of our God.

M:  This is the generation of those who seek the Lord
W:  (This is the generation of those who seek the Lord)
        This is the generation called to prepare His way

So rallied round His standard raised high
Men of dust now raised to the sky
Side by side, eye to eye
“He is Lord!” as one we’ll cry
And then all the world will see
The salvation of our God

W:  Who is the King of glory, who is He?
M:  He is the Lord both strong and mighty
W:  Who is the King of glory, who is He?
M:  The Lord Almighty He is the King of glory! 

M:  This is the generation of those who seek the Lord
W:  (This is the generation of those who seek the Lord)
        This is the generation called to prepare His way

And ev’ry valley shall be lifted up,
Ev’ry mountain and hill be made low,
And the crooked roads straight,
The rough places plain and then all the world will see
The Salvation of our God.

The Salvation of our God. (3x)

songs.title: THEREFORE THE REDEEMED
slides:
Therefore the redeemed of the Lord shall return
And come with singing unto Zion
And everlasting joy shall be upon their head
(Repeat)

They shall obtain gladness and joy
And sorrow and mourning shall flee away
Therefore the redeemed of the Lord shall return
And come unto singing unto Zion
And everlasting joy shall be upon their Head.

songs.title: THERE’S A NEW GENERATION
slides:
There’s a new generation, that is seeking Your face
There’s a new generation, that is taking their place
Lord, we surrender to your will let it be done
Come this day, have your way
Let  Your kingdom come

(Repeat)

We will rise (We will rise), we will run (we will run)

We will rise (We will rise), we will run (we will run)

songs.title: THINE O LORD
slides:
Thine O Lord, it is all thine, the greatness, the pow’r
And the glory, the victory, the majesty.
For all that is in heav’n and earth
It all is thine.  It all is thine.

Thine is the kingdom, O Lord.
Thou art exalted above all riches and honor
Come from Thee and over all Thou rulest

Thine O Lord, it is all thine, the greatness, the pow’r
And the glory, the victory, the majesty.
For all that is in heav’n and earth
It all is thine.  It all is thine.

Power and might are in Thy hands

our God, and praise Thy glorious name

Thine O Lord, it is all thine, the greatness, the pow’r
And the glory, the victory, the majesty.
For all that is in heav’n and earth
It all is thine.  It all is thine.

songs.title: THIS IS HOW WE OVERCOME
slides:
Your light broke through my night
Restored exceeding joy
Your grace fell like the rain
And made this desert live

You have turned my mourning into dancing
You have turned my sorrow into joy

Your hand lifted me up 
I stand on higher ground
Your praise rose in my heart
And made this valley sing

You have turned my mourning into dancing
You have turned my sorrow into joy
(Repeat)

This is how we overcome.  This is how overcome.
This is how we overcome.  This is how overcome
This is how we overcome.  This is how overcome
This is how we overcome.  This is how overcome
This is how we overcome.  (8x)

You have turned my mourning into dancing
You have turned my sorrow into joy
(Repeat)

songs.title: THOU ART WORTHY
slides:
Thou art worthy.  Thou art worthy
Thou art worthy, O Lord.
Thou art worthy to receive glory,
Glory and honor and power
For Thou hast created, 
Hast all things created
For thou hast created all things
And for thy pleasure they are created.
Thou art worthy, O Lord.

songs.title: THROUGH YOU I WILL BRING LIGHT TO THE NATIONS
slides:
Rise now, my children, my chosen ones,
Come and heed my call.
Rise now, my children, it’s time to go
To heal our hurting world
To heal our hurting world.  Yes…

Through you, I will bring light to the nations
Through you, I will bring light to the nations

I, the Lord, have called you for the sake of justice
I will hold you by the hand
I will form you and set you
As a covenant to the people.

Through you, I will bring light to the nations
Through you, I will bring light to the nations

Go forth then, my children;
Tread the paths which no one dare
Onward move, I’ll lead you
My Spirit guides and gives you strength
To conquer the whole world for me.

Through you, I will bring light to the nations
Through you, I will bring light to the nations

songs.title: THROUGH YOU I WILL BRING LIGHT TO THE NATIONS
slides:
Be my lamps shining bright
Give my hope and share my love
To the men who know me not
So the blind may see and captives be free
Lead those in darkness to light

Through you, I will bring light to the nations
Through you, I will bring light to the nations
Yes, you are my chosen ones
Go forth, the time is now.

songs.title: THROUGH YOU I WILL GIVE LIGHT TO THE NATIONS
slides:
Through you I will give light to the nations
And give joy unto the lowly
To heal the broken-hearted and set the captives free
Through you  I will grant my blessings
on all those who mourn,
For I have anointed you and set you for My own

I have formed you and called you by your name.
I have brought you and held you by My hand.
I have sealed you, engraved inside My heart.
You are precious and glorious in My sight.

I will turn your darkness into light
I will make all crooked ways straight
I will do all these My people.
I will not forsake you.

Through you I will give light to the nations
And give joy unto the lowly
To heal the broken-hearted and set the captives free
Through you  I will grant my blessings 
on all those who mourn,
For I have anointed you and set you for My own

songs.title: THROUGH YOU I WILL GIVE LIGHT TO THE NATIONS
slides:
Cross the seas and you will not get drowned
Walk through fire and you will not get burned
Lead the blind though they have eyes to see
Lead the deaf though they have ears to hear.

You’ll be called priests and ministers of God.
You’ll be filled with the riches of the world.
Everlasting joy shall dawn on you

songs.title: THROUGH YOU I WILL GIVE LIGHT TO THE NATIONS

songs.title: TILL THE END OF MY TIME

Worthy, worthy, worthy is the Lamb, who was slain

songs.title: VICTORY TO OUR KING
slides:
All glory unto You
This battle cry we sing
That victory belongs to Him
Victory to our King

All glory unto You
This battle cry we sing
That victory belongs to Him
Victory to our King

All glory unto You
This battle cry we sing

songs.title: WAKE FROM YOUR SLEEP
slides:
Wake from your sleep, a Savior is born.
God’s holy child gives light to this morn,
All our darkness to dispel.
Praise to our God whose glory we tell.

Come from your fields as shepherds of old.
Welcome to this child whom prophets foretold.
God has made the earth His home.
Praise to our God, the Savior has come.

Stay with us now, O Lord of the earth.
Make of our hearts a place for Your birth.
Though our cares be great or small, 
Jesus the Lord, be born in us all.

Now shall the earth take joy in her tears.
Now shall our hearts be turned from their fears.
All the earth shall sing God’s praise.
Jesus the Lord, be born on this day.

If it’s you Lord I will go
Speak out Lord for I will listen

slides:
None of us lives as his own

For both in life and death we belong to God,
That is why Christ has died for us and come again.
We shall all appear before the judgment seat of God
For it is written, “Evr’y knee shall bend before me
And ev’ry tongue shall give praise to God”

For we are sure that neither death nor life,
Nor this nor future, ages nor their pow’rs,

songs.title: AWAY IN A MANGER
slides:
Away in a manger, no crib for a bed,
The little Lord Jesus laid down His sweet head.
The stars in the sky looked down where He lay.
The little Lord Jesus, asleep on the hay.

The cattle are lowing, the baby awakes,
but little Lord Jesus, no crying He makes.
I love Thee, Lord Jesus, look down from the sky,
And stay by my cradle till morning is nigh.

Be near me, Lord Jesus, I ask Thee to stay
Close by me forever, and love me, I pray.
Bless all the dear children in Thy tender care
And fit us for heaven to live with Thee there.  Amen.

songs.title: BETHLEHEM REJOICES

Bethlehem rejoices!  Hark the voices clear,
Singing in the starlight, nearer and more near

Unto God be glory, peace to men be given;
This is His will who dwelleth in the heights of heaven

Heaven cannot contain Him, nor the bounds of earth.
Yet, oh glorious mystery!  Virgin gives Him birth

songs.title: EMMANUEL
slides:
Baby born in a stall.  Long ago now and hard to recall
Cold wind, darkness and sin,
Your welcoming from us all.

How can it be true?  A world grown so old now,
How can it be new?  Sorrow’s end, God send,
Born now for me and you

Emmanuel, Emmanuel, 
What are we that You have loved us so well?
A song on high, a Savior’s nigh, angel hosts rejoice
Thy Glory to tell.

Lord, lead us to know, You lay like a beggar,
So humble, so low;
No place for Your head and straw for a bed,
The glory of God to show.

Babe on mother’s knee,
Child so soon to be nailed to a tree;
All praise, till the end of our days;
O Lord, You have set us free.

Emmanuel, Emmanuel, 
What are we that You have loved us so well?
A song on high, a Savior’s nigh, angel hosts rejoice
Thy Glory to tell.

songs.title: HARK! THE HERALD ANGELS SING
slides:
Hark! The herald angels sing,
“Glory to the new born King;
Peace on earth, and mercy mild,
God and sinners reconciled!”
Joyful, all ye nations, rise,
Join the triumph of the skies;
With th’ angelic host proclaim,
“Christ is born in Bethlehem!”

Hark! The herald angels sing,
“Glory to the new born King;

Christ, by highest heaven adored,
Christ the everlasting Lord,
Late in time behold Him come,
Offspring of a virgin’s womb.
Veiled in flesh the God-head see;
Hail th’ incarnate Deity!
Pleased as man with men to dwell,
Jesus, our Emmanuel.

Hark! The herald angels sing,
“Glory to the new born King;

Hail the heaven-born Prince of peace!
Hail the sun of Righteousness!
Light and life to all He brings,
Risen with healing in His wings.
Mild He lays His glory by,  
Born that man no more may die,
Born to raise the sons of earth,
Born to give them second birth.

No more let sins and sorrow grow,
Nor thorns infest the ground;
He comes to make His blessings flow
Far as the curse is found, Far as the curse is found,
Far as, far as the curse is found

He rules the world with truth and grace,
And makes the nations prove the glories of His
Righteousness, and wonders of His love, and wonders of His Love, 
And wonders, wonders of His love

O come, let us adore Him

O come, let us adore Him

songs.title: O COME O COME EMMANUEL

That mourns in lonely exile here,

songs.title: O COME, O COME EMMANUEL
slides:
Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel
Shall come to thee, O Israel!  Amen.

O come, Thou Day, spring, come and cheer
Our spirits by Thine advent here;
Disperse the gloomy clouds of night,
And death’s dark shadows put to flight.

Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel
Shall come to thee, O Israel!  Amen.

O come, Thou Wisdom from on high,
And order all things, far and nigh;
To us the path of knowledge show,
And cause us in her ways to go.

Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel
Shall come to thee, O Israel!  Amen.

O come, desire of nations, bind
All peoples in one heart and mind;
Bid envy, strife, and quarrels cease,
Fill the whole world with heaven’s peace

Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel
Shall come to thee, O Israel!  Amen.

songs.title: O HOLY NIGHT
slides:
O holy night the stars are brightly shining,
It is the night of the dear Savior’s birth.
Long lay the world in sin and error pining.
Till he appeared and the soul felt its worth.
A thrill of hope the weary soul rejoices,
For yonder breaks a new and glorious morn;
Fall on your knees, Oh hear the angel voices!
O night divine, O night, when Christ was born!
O night, O holy night, O night divine.

Led by the light of faith serenely beaming,
With glowing hearts by his cradle we stand;
So led by light of a star sweetly gleaming,
Here came the wise men from Orient land.
The King of kings lay thus in lowly manger,
In all our trials born to be our friend;
He knows our need, to our weakness is no stranger
Behold your King, before him lowly bend!
Behold your King, before him lowly bend!

songs.title: O LITTLE TOWN OF BETHLEHEM
slides:
O little town of Bethlehem, how still we see thee lie!
Above thy deep and dreamless sleep
The silent stars go by
Yet in thy dark streets shineth the everlasting light;
The hopes and fears of all the years
Are met in thee tonight

For Christ is born of Mary, and gathered all above,
While mortals sleep, the angels keep
Their watch of wondering love.
O morning stars, together proclaim the holy birth!
And praises sing to God the King.
And peace to men on earth.

How silently, how silently, the wondrous gift is given
So God imparts to human hearts
The blessings of His heaven
No ear may hear His coming, but in this world of sin;
Where meek souls will receive Him,
Still the dear Christ enters in.

Round yon virgin, mother and child,
Holy infant, so tender and mild,
Sleep in heavenly peace,
Sleep in heavenly peace.

Silent night! Holy night!  
Shepherds quake at the night
Glories stream from heaven afar,
Heavenly hosts sing Alleluia!
Christ the Savior is born!
Christ the Savior is born!

Silent night! Holy night!  
Son of God, love’s pure light
Radiant beams from Thy holy face,
With the dawn of redeeming grace, 
Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth
Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth
